problem: The Parking Jam prototype could build and render while code structure, assets, bundle size, performance, and UI interactions regressed unnoticed.
reuseDecision: The implementation extends the existing architecture and GitHub Actions validation layer instead of introducing a second test harness or runtime.
acceptance: Strict TypeScript checking runs against the pinned Modoki toolchain and includes test sources
Generated levels, source files, GLB assets, and browser bundle have ratchets
Existing debt ceilings are reduced through semantic splits rather than raised for quality fixes
Weak-device quality tiers reduce pixel ratio, shadows, crowd size, and decoration density without changing domain state
Real browser interactions, layout, load, paint, and heap contracts run across six viewports
All reports and screenshots are retained as CI artifacts
